about: Outputs of the scripts in this directory, run on 2026-11-07 on the instances exported by export_spheres.py (count_lib.signed_space(octa_dual(k)), k = 2..8). Each run stops at the first instance not refuted within the limit. Experiment evidence, not proof.

limits.CaDiCaL (CDCL): 600 s per instance (k = 7 was stopped at 2476 s because the solver did not honour the interrupt)

encodings.Exact (cutting planes): one pseudo-Boolean constraint per line: 1 <= y_a + y_b + y_c <= 2 over the line's literals
encodings.CryptoMiniSat (XOR): a parity variable e = x_a xor x_b per pair of points in a line (native XOR constraint) and, per line, the clause 'pair (a,b) or pair (b,c) disagrees' over those parity variables
encodings.CaDiCaL (CDCL): the formula's own clauses (two per line)
